question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"Throw cold water on something"
solution:
The correct answer is: **1) To discourage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Throw cold water on something"** means to discourage or reduce enthusiasm for an idea, plan, or activity. (उत्साह को कम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager threw cold water on our proposal by pointing out its flaws.
 
 
• The correct meaning of the idiom is **"To discourage"**. (हतोत्साहित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** His negative comments threw cold water on their excitement for the project.
